reason: With the wedding coming I want the hall, the front room and the outside wall facing the road looking fresh, not every room in the flat. ₹78,000 for the whole house is close to a month's pay when the wedding is already eating our savings, and I'm not going to pay for bedrooms nobody will see.
objection: It's one fixed price for everything, and I only need some walls done. I'm also sitting in the Gulf while my parents deal with the crew, so I'd want to know exactly who turns up and that they won't leave a mess for my father to argue about.
would_change_my_mind: A smaller package for just the living room and the front exterior at around ₹25,000-30,000, finished on a fixed date before the wedding, that I can book and pay for online from abroad with photo updates sent to me.
